name: Francis Galton
summary: British polymath known for founding eugenics, developing statistical methods like correlation and regression, and establishing fingerprint classification systems.

name: Charles Darwin
summary: British naturalist and Galton's cousin, known for the theory of evolution by natural selection.

name: Karl Pearson
summary: British mathematician and biostatistician who was mentored by Galton and wrote his biography.

name: Joseph Jacobs
summary: Anthropologist and historian of Jewish culture who collaborated with Galton on composite photography.

name: Douglas Galton
aliases: Douglas Galton of the Royal Engineers
summary: Galton's cousin who introduced him to the Royal Geographical Society.

name: Royal Geographical Society
summary: Learned society that sponsored Galton's African expedition and awarded him a Gold medal.

name: British Association for the Advancement of Science
summary: Scientific organization where Galton served as president of the Anthropometric and Racial Committee.

name: Anthropometric and Racial Committee
summary: Subcommittee of the British Association chaired by Galton to study racial types in the British Isles.

name: General Hospital Birmingham
summary: Hospital where Galton undertook a medical apprenticeship.

name: The Times
summary: National newspaper where Galton published a letter from Southern Africa.

name: London
summary: Capital city of the United Kingdom, where Galton lived and worked.

name: Southern Africa
summary: Region where Galton conducted his major exploration expedition.

name: Europe
summary: Continent where Galton travelled in his youth.

name: Constantinople
summary: City Galton visited during his 1840 independent travel.

name: Hereditary Genius
aliases: Hereditary Genius: An Inquiry into Its Laws and Consequences
summary: Book published by Galton in 1869 on the statistical analysis of heredity and eminence.

name: Inquiries into Human Faculty and Its Development
summary: Book published by Galton in 1883 where he coined the term 'eugenics'.

name: Finger Prints
summary: Book published by Galton on fingerprint classification and identification.

name: Narrative of an Explorer in Tropical South Africa
aliases: Narrative of an Explorer in South Africa
summary: Book published by Galton in 1853 detailing his African exploration.

name: The Art of Travel
aliases: The Art of Travel or Shifts and Contrivances Available in Wild Countries
summary: Book published by Galton in 1855 on survival in wild countries.

name: Hereditary Talent and Character
summary: Two-part article published by Galton in 1865 on hereditary transmission of talent.

name: Fingerprint Classification
summary: System developed by Galton for indexing and classifying fingerprints.

name: Composite Photography
summary: Technique developed by Galton to create averaged images of groups to identify typical features.
